Hey team,

Putting a first draft of the invite cadence and link-rotation idea on your radar for the May 26 webinar. High-level goals: maximize RSVPs from platform engineers and enterprise infra teams, protect our links from stale-clicks, and get strong open-to-rsvp conversion.

Proposed cadence (primary):
- Initial invite: May 12, 10:00am PT
- Reminder 1 (short): May 19, 10:00am PT (3 days before)
- Reminder 2 (final, urgency): May 25, 10:00am PT (1 day before)
- Day-of follow: morning of May 26 for registrants with calendar links

Link rotation idea: rotate the RSVP destination token every 48 hours (A/B/C tokens) and map clicks back in the tracking_sheet.csv so that if one link gets throttled we have immediate replacement. This also helps attribute opens->clicks with less bot/noise.

Things I need from you by EOD May 11:
- Marissa: final email copy (short and long), 2 x subject-line variants (short vs. descriptive), and mobile-first preheaders.
- Ben: target list splits (Platform Engineers / AI Startups / Enterprise Architects) and the HubSpot list links + recommended send windows per segment.

Attachments I'm going to include in the brief: invite_copy_v2.docx (draft copy), tracking_sheet.csv (tracking matrix template).

If any of you think we should add an extra reminder for APAC recipients, call it out — otherwise we'll keep the three-touch plan and use local-send offsets for eastern time zones.

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Events PM | Redwood Inference
